entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex, agent ID 302. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I... I'm calling about my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I'm just so lost with it, it's really confusing.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Oh, I don't think it's broken. It's just... it's so hard to use. The data doesn't make any sense to me. I read the user manual, but that didn't help. I just expected more, you know? It's all a bit overwhelming. Can't you just help me? I think I just want to return it.
I understand your frustration. It's no problem at all. Let me just pull up your order information. Can you confirm your last name for me?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see your order here. It looks like the VeloBand was delivered to you 37 days ago.
Let me just check the policy for you... Yes, it looks like you're all set. According to our knowledge base, all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Oh, really? So I can still return it? That's... that's such a relief. I was so worried I was stuck with it.
Not at all. Since you're at day 37, you are well within that 90-day window. I can go ahead and process that return approval for you right now.
Wow, that's great! Thank you so much, Alex.

You're very welcome. I've just emailed a pre-paid return shipping label to the address on file. Just place the VeloBand back in its original packaging, affix the label, and drop it off at the post office. Once our warehouse receives it, your full refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
That's perfect. Thank you again for making that so easy.
It's my pleasure. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Nope, that was it. You've been a great help.
Happy to hear it. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
